Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Naira - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Neeta - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Sharda - 75 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Rishabh - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Kunal stands in the snow. Neeta, Naira and Rishabh stand near him.]

Naira: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Naira: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Kunal (surprised): "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Kunal: "Grandma, look over here."

[Kunal munches on an apple.]

Naira: "What happened?"

[Kunal sits down on a chair.]

Neeta (happily): "Okay, Mother."

[Kunal sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Neeta: "Really?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Neeta: "Let's begin."

[Naira draws a rangoli at the door.]

Naira: "This is amazing!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Naira (excited): "Mom, listen!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Naira: "That was such a fun day!"
